description: Liquidation map for one Hyperliquid main-dex coin from the most active accounts (public leaderboard, refreshed every 15 min): longs/shorts {positions, notional_usd, avg_entry}, liquidation_bands[] (side, from_pct/to_pct from mark, price range, notional_usd), nearest_long/short_liquidation {price, distance_pct, cluster_notional_usd}, liquidations_24h (confirmed by Hyperliquid's liquidation marker), coverage_pct_of_oi.
